## Requirements (from the contract §In-scope)
1. Derive sharing/access edges (3 access-edge types + access-path closure) from real claims over the
   RESOLVED entity set; materialise them as a NEW sqitch change (deploy/revert/verify), append-only,
   idempotent re-run (+0).
2. Each edge carries its support glyph + evidence classes; disagreements surface as VISIBLE
   contradictions (NOT silently reconciled — P28.3's job).
3. Feed the web network island / list-equivalent a real edge dataset (consumed later by P28.5).

## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)
- [ ] sharing/access edges materialised over resolved entities (new sqitch change; append-only; idempotent) *(deterministic + live-gated)*
- [ ] edges carry support glyphs + evidence provenance; the §29.3/§29.7 logic is reused, not re-implemented *(deterministic)*
- [ ] `make check` + `make test-db` + build-memory green *(deterministic)*

## Cross-cutting invariants
Append-only (edges = new rows; NO UPDATE/DELETE); every inference labelled; contradictions stay
visible; §29.3/§29.7 logic owned by P08.2 CONSUMED not re-implemented (SIG-ENG-035); §19.4; never a
total (§32); Part VIII.

## Plan
- **New sqitch change `relationship_materialize`** (deps [relationships]): add nullable `input_digest`
  to `relationship` + partial UNIQUE index `relationship_input_digest_key`. Mirrors
  `resolution_materialize`/`claim_content_digest` (ADR-099/ADR-059) — insert-only `ON CONFLICT DO
  NOTHING` → idempotent +0. Additive/back-compat (nullable, no default).
- **`reconcile/materialize.py`** — add `materialize_sharing_edges(conn, ...)`:
  read sharing-edge claims (predicate → access_kind map; entity_ref partner) from the spine, build
  `SharingObservation`s, run `reconcile_sharing` (**P08.2 — reused**), INSERT `relationship` rows
  append-only + idempotent. `to_org` must resolve to an entity (object_entity) to materialise;
  name-only partners are still reconciled (asymmetry complete) but counted skipped_unmapped.
  Returns `EdgeMaterializeSummary` incl. contradictions (kept VISIBLE — returned, NOT written; P28.3).
  edge_type = access_kind (§12.5: access_kind is "which of the three edge types of §12.2"; §12.9).
  `read_materialized_edges(conn)` — the real edge dataset seam P28.5 consumes.
- **`reconcile materialize-edges --dsn`** CLI.
- **`inference access-paths --dsn`** — read the materialised edges → `close_access_paths` (**P12.2 —
  reused**) → derived L4 closure (feeds the web `access_paths`, currently `[]`). Layering: inference
  depends on reconcile (not vice versa), so closure-over-spine lives in inference.
- Live: run over hosted spine if ADC available; else prove on the seeded PG test DB + honest deferral.
